notes.title: Uroboros City Builder "The Last Martian". First Contact
notes.content:
People of earth...
heed my message

[previewyoutube=g_LtUDyWFUU;full][/previewyoutube]

The planet of mars
has fallen
we were lied to
by our government
They hid
What the advancement of technology
really means
and so
the enemy
the one we have created
has won
now...
I am the last of my people
people of earth...
I want you to learn from our mistakes
for the enemy
It's coming for you now
if you fight it alone...
you might as well give up on all hope now
that's why the earth has to unite
united the earth might stand a chance
united the earth can survive 
united the earth can fight back
end of message

- The Last Martian

To be continued...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2437120/The_Last_Martian/
